lead_raw_text:
The structure of Tb₂Mg₁₄Ag₂ (TbMg₇Ag) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 18 atoms per unit cell distributed over seven independent Wyckoff orbits. CrystalNN geometry-only analysis shows Ag, Mg, and Tb centers each adopt close-packed-like local arrangements with 12 geometric neighbors; Mg environments are mainly 12-coordinate with mixed Ag, Mg, and Tb neighbors, while Tb is surrounded by 12 Mg neighbors. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 18 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis identifies corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between 12-vertex Mg-centered polyhedra, and corner- and edge-sharing between Mg and Tb or Ag-centered polyhedra.
